'''Dominic Gaudreault Why Dom Scrub Out of the Ottawa GS 2K (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Dominic Gaudreault]] posted on DeckTech on 24 May 2000 about [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam]].<ref name="tr-d805">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-24-why-dom-scrub-out-of-the-ottawa-gs-2kd805/ why-dom-scrub-out-of-the-ottawa-gs-2k], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 24 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-24-why-dom-scrub-out-of-the-ottawa-gs-2kd805/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Dominic Gaudreault went 3–3 (6 (−30)) at the 2000 Ottawa Grand Slam with Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi and a Throne Room insert beatdown deck, beating Brian Terwilliger and Steve Brentson.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Dominic Gaudreault]] (byline: Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault)
* '''Published:''' 24 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Why Dom Scrub Out of the Ottawa GS 2K''
* '''Event:''' [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam]]
* '''Event date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Players:''' 38
* '''Record:''' 3–3
* '''Points:''' 6 (−30)
* '''Dark deck:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ with Responsibility Of Command / Much Anger In Him ('Why Myriam Is My Woman')]]
* '''Light deck:''' Throne Room insert beatdown based on Juz's Revenge ('Why I Am The King Of Beatdown')

  First, I sugest you drink lots of beer or smoke some weed before reading this tournement report.



Hey Wuzzup ? Well, that was the first tournemnt I played that was not in Quebec. And there were a lot of good player from the US, so that was like a test for me, to see if I was really good, or if I sucked a$$.



But first I want to say, I went to my 3rd magic tournement last friday, and I had told my friend Jo that I was gonna win with my Sligh deck ( that's a really gay deck) ( I had 6 sideboard card for some anti-Troll Albinos Tech, lol). He said that If I ever win I was his idol. Well I win (on a last turn topdeck in the final), so now I am his Idol :) Anyways, Magic is a crappy game base 70 % on matchup and luck, but it's just fun to play.



So now, I'll start talking about the tournement. Well, my head was somewere else those past 2 weeks, so I only played 6 games and a half in those 2 week before the Grand Slam.
